name: Postgres Pro
tagline: Russian commercial PostgreSQL distribution with multimaster, 64-bit XIDs and compressed storage.
description: Postgres Pro is a family of PostgreSQL-based distributions from Postgres Professional, the Moscow company founded in 2015 by long-time PostgreSQL core contributors. Standard tracks upstream with extra extensions, while Enterprise adds substantial engine changes: 64-bit transaction IDs (no wraparound), the CFS compressed file system, multimaster replication, autonomous transactions, built-in connection pooling and improved partitioning and locking. It is certified for Russian regulatory requirements and widely used in Russian government, banking and import-substitution projects, which also limits its availability and support in many Western markets.

pricing.notes: Free for evaluation and development; production use requires a commercial license.

scale.notes: Enterprise multimaster provides synchronous multi-node writes; Shardman (separate product) adds sharding.

strengths: 64-bit XIDs in Enterprise remove transaction-wraparound emergencies
CFS page compression shrinks storage for large databases
Multimaster cluster for synchronous HA writes
Built by core PostgreSQL contributors who upstream many features
Certified for Russian security and import-substitution requirements
weaknesses: Proprietary license and vendor lock-in for Enterprise-only features
Sanctions and geography limit procurement and support outside Russia/CIS
Few managed cloud offerings on global hyperscalers
Enterprise on-disk format diverges from community PostgreSQL
useCases: Very large OLTP databases hitting XID wraparound limits
notIdealFor: Organizations outside Russia/CIS needing vendor support
